label: Cargo: Ultra Clippy (Strict)
command: cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings -D clippy::all -D clippy::pedantic -D clippy::nursery -D clippy::restriction

label: Cargo: Export OpenAPI
command: mkdir -p generated/openapi && cargo run --bin export_openapi -- generated/openapi/gridstack-openapi.json

label: Redocly: Export OpenAPI to html
command: mkdir -p generated/openapi && docker run --rm -v "$PWD:/spec" redocly/cli build-docs generated/openapi/gridstack-openapi.json -o generated/openapi/gridstack-redocly.html

label: Docs: Rebuild OpenAPI + Redocly
command: cargo run --bin export_openapi -- gridstack-openapi.json && docker run --rm -v "$PWD:/spec" redocly/cli build-docs generated/openapi/gridstack-openapi.json -o gridstack-redocly.html

label: Matrix: Sync & Generate OpenAPI
command: mkdir -p temp && cd temp && if [ ! -d "matrix-spec" ]; then git clone https://github.com/matrix-org/matrix-spec.git; fi && cd matrix-spec && git pull && python3 -m venv venv && source venv/bin/activate && pip install -r ./scripts/requirements.txt && python ./scripts/dump-openapi.py && mkdir -p ../../generated/openapi/ && cp ./scripts/openapi/api-docs.json ../../generated/openapi/matrix-openapi.json

label: Matrix: Sync & Generate OpenAPI + Redocly
command: mkdir -p temp && cd temp && if [ ! -d "matrix-spec" ]; then git clone https://github.com/matrix-org/matrix-spec.git; fi && cd matrix-spec && git pull && python3 -m venv venv && source venv/bin/activate && pip install -r ./scripts/requirements.txt && python ./scripts/dump-openapi.py && mkdir -p ../../generated/openapi/ && cp ./scripts/openapi/api-docs.json ../../generated/openapi/matrix-openapi.json && docker run --rm -v "$PWD:/spec" redocly/cli build-docs generated/openapi/matrix-openapi.json -o generated/openapi/matrix-redocly.html

label: DB: Dump Schema Only
command: mkdir -p generated/db && pg_dump --schema-only --no-owner --no-privileges -U admin -d gridstack -h localhost -p 5432 > generated/db/schema.sql
